title: 29 1.8.2 A noticeable decrease in the percentage share was observed in the case of 'Murder', 'C.H. not amounting to Murder', 'Dacoity', 'Robbery', 'Theft', 'Riots', 'Criminal Breach of Trust' and 'Counterfeiting', while incidence of 'Cheating', 'Rape', 'Kidnapping & Abduction of Women & girls', increased with varying degrees. The uncategorised crimes clubbed under 'Other IPC Crimes' constituted more than half (55.4%) of the total crimes.
